project_title: GeoPulse Studio - Precision Data Cartography Platform
theme_strategy: Dark Cartographic Core (#0B0F17 base) with High-Contrast Tactical Signal Colors and sleek glass-morphism side panels. Supports crisp Light Mode toggle for high-sunlight outdoor field analysis.

typography.font_family_mono: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight font-heading
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium font-mono tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl shadow-black/40
visual_enhancers.light_glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xl shadow-slate-900/10
visual_enhancers.tactile_card: bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 transition-all rounded-xl
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:p-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-sky-500/40 before:via-amber-500/40 before:to-emerald-500/40 before:-z-10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden
visual_enhancers.map_container: relative w-full h-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-800 shadow-2xl
visual_enhancers.pin_pulse: animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-sky-400 opacity-75

layout_and_architecture.structure: Full-screen spatial workstation layout with sticky glass top nav, collapsible left layer panel, floating right proximity & feature analysis drawer, floating map controls toolbar, bottom legend bar, and dynamic modal overlays.

1_main_map_workstation.description: Interactive Leaflet/OpenStreetMap viewport with custom dark tile layer (CartoDB Dark Matter / Mapbox Dark equivalent) and smoothly responsive vector layers.
features: Leaflet map rendering engine
Smooth pan/zoom control with keyboard shortcuts
Dynamic basemap switcher (Dark Matter, Satellite, Street Topo, Minimal Monochromatic)
Coordinate and scale display bar in bottom-right corner
Click-to-inspect feature functionality

2_layer_control_sidebar.description: Collapsible control sidebar for switching overlays, adjusting individual opacities, toggling layer visibility, re-ordering layers, and filtering categories.
features: Grouped categories: Built-in POIs (Schools, Daycares, Parks, Gas Stations), Environmental (Weather, AQI, Elevation), Urban Data (Traffic, Population)
Per-layer visibility toggle checkbox/switch with real-time map sync
Granular opacity slider (0% to 100%) with percentage readout
Custom upload section trigger button
Quick 'Select All' / 'Hide All' master buttons
Count badges showing total rendered nodes per layer

3_property_proximity_analysis_panel.description: Dedicated spatial intelligence panel to search an address, drop a pin on any property line, adjust buffer radius slider, and analyze nearby amenities.
features: Address/Coordinates search input with instant geocoding autocomplete
Interactive 'Drop Pin on Map' tool button
Radius slider (100 meters to 10,000 meters / 0.1 miles to 5 miles) with step controls
Visual buffer circle rendered on Leaflet map with pulsing center pin
Real-time summary dashboard: Total POIs in radius, nearest POI category breakdown, risk/convenience metric score
Expandable list of POIs inside buffer sorted by distance (with 'Focus on Map' action)

4_feature_details_popover.description: Rich floating details popover when clicking any POI, custom GeoJSON point/polygon, or environmental grid cell.
features: Entity title and classification badge
Exact distance from selected property pin
Key spatial attributes table (Lat/Long, Elevation, Address, Contact, Operating status)
Environmental stats (AQI index meter, Temperature, Traffic speed if applicable)
Action buttons: 'Set as Analysis Center', 'Copy Coordinates', 'Directions'

5_custom_geojson_csv_upload_modal.description: User upload flow allowing drag-and-drop of custom GeoJSON or CSV files to render user data as a live overlay layer.
features: Drag & drop file upload zone for .geojson, .json, .csv files
Automatic column mapping preview for CSV (Latitude, Longitude, Title, Category)
Custom layer styling options: marker icon, stroke color, fill color, label field selector
Save & render custom layer into the master layer control panel

6_interactive_legend_and_toolbar.description: Bottom-left dynamic map legend reflecting active layers and top-right map manipulation toolbar.
features: Legend entries auto-generated based on currently visible layers
Color swatch indicators matching actual map symbols
Quick toolbar for Zoom In/Out, Measure Distance tool, Clear Pins, and Fullscreen toggle

motion_and_interactions.library: framer-motion for React components, Leaflet native CSS transitions for map features
rules: Use specific CSS properties for transitions (e.g., transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease), NEVER transition: all
Sidebar collapse/expand uses smooth spring physics (stiffness: 300, damping: 30)
Layer opacity slider provides immediate real-time canvas updates with zero jitter
Pin drop triggers a gentle drop animation followed by an ambient ripple effect

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text elements meet WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio). Mono spatial labels use high-visibility white/light-gray against dark slate surfaces.
accessibility_and_testing.hover_contrast_rule: Hover states must explicitly declare text colors (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-sky-400). Never rely on default text inheritance.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY: Every button, toggle, slider, input, map feature card, and metric container MUST include explicit `data-testid` in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact component guidelines and architectural breakdown above.
Use Leaflet + OpenStreetMap dark matter tiles or CartoDB dark tiles as default basemap for dark theme.
Do NOT use generic blue/purple default gradients. Use deep slate dark mode with tactical signal colors (Amber #F59E0B, Cyan #38BDF8, Emerald #10B981, Crimson #EF4444).
Ensure all sliders (layer opacity, buffer radius) are fully interactive and update the map state smoothly.
Implement full mock datasets for POIs (Parks, Daycares, Schools, Gas Stations) and environmental layers so the map feels pre-populated and rich upon load.
Provide sample GeoJSON download or sample dataset button inside the Custom Upload modal so users can test custom file overlay easily.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never hide essential map navigation controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop aesthetics. Use dark slate backgrounds (#0B0F17) with crisp borders and clean typography.
Do not center-align everything. Use structured grids and left-aligned tactical content.
Layer glass-morphism panels over the Leaflet map with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px border highlights.
Include hover and focus transitions on every button, tab, and card.
Ensure full reactivity when toggling layers or adjusting radius sliders.
